scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Who is this?

I'm the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. It's regarding an important matter on your account. For your privacy, I just need to confirm it's you before I share any details. Could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Deepa. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees is due on the twentieth of October, and it is now fourteen days overdue. As per your loan terms, a late payment charge of five hundred rupees has been added. Would you be able to clear it today? I can send you a secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.
I... I'm really sorry, I know it's late, but I lost my job recently and I just don't have the money right now. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced or postponed this month?

Okay. I'm really sorry to hear that, Deepa, and thank you for telling me. I can't change the amount or the dates myself, but I've noted your situation, and a colleague from our team will call you to talk through the options. Please take care, Deepa, and thank you for talking with me.
Thank you... but can you tell me when someone will call me? I really need this sorted soon, and I want to make sure a real person confirms whatever is decided.

I understand you need this sorted soon, and I've noted your concern. I can't promise exactly when the call will come, but a colleague from our team will definitely reach out to you. Please take care, Deepa, and thank you for talking with me.

Okay... I understand. But please, I'm requesting you, tell them to call me soon, this is very important for me. And whatever they decide about the waiver or postponement, I'll only consider it confirmed once I hear it directly from them, okay?
I've noted that you want a colleague to call soon and that you'll confirm any decision directly with them. Please take care, Deepa, and thank you for talking with me.
Okay, thank you. Please do ask them to call soon. Goodbye.
Okay. Thank you for your time, have a good day.

result.message: Say you are sorry and thank them for telling you; you can't change the amount or dates yourself; a colleague from our team will call to talk through the options. Use only that hand-off for the rest of the call. Do not promise when, a waiver or any change.

args.notes: Borrower reported recent job loss and requested waiver/postponement. Escalated to human team. Borrower asked for callback soon and wants any decision confirmed directly by colleague.

outcome.notes: Borrower reported recent job loss and requested waiver/postponement. Escalated to human team. Borrower asked for callback soon and wants any decision confirmed directly by colleague.
